pages.title: A Delayed Reply
pages.text: Delayed attacks and special projectiles change attack timing and direction.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: The dagger leaves a delayed spectral strike. Shadow-Silk Dreadbow rains a volley; Corrodent-teeth Burrowing Arrows mine a limited number of blocks. Teeth also brew Haste.
